title: A Comparative Benchmark of a Moroccan Darija Toxicity Detection Model (Typica.ai) and Major LLM-Based Moderation APIs (OpenAI, Mistral, Anthropic)

bias_targets.methodology: Comparative benchmarking of general-purpose moderation APIs against a dialect-specific model using a balanced Moroccan Darija dataset to measure performance disparities (precision, recall, F1-score) on a low-resource language.

Qualitative error analysis of model outputs to evaluate their failure in detecting culturally embedded toxicity, localized idioms, context-dependent insults, and sarcasm specific to Moroccan online discourse.
